title: Recursive Least Squares Estimator
text: Estimate model coefficients using recursive least squares (RLS) algorithm, 8 inputs, 3 outputs, {External reset} sets trigger for external reset; {Initial Estimate} sets the source of initial parameter estimates, {Number of Parameters} sets the number of parameters to estimate, {Parameter Covariance Matrix} sets the initial parameter covariance 1e4, {Initial Parameter Values} sets the initial values of the parameters to estimate, {Initial Regressors} sets the initial values of the regressors buffer, {Initial Outputs} sets the initial values of the measured outputs, {Input Processing} sets the sample-based or frame-based processing, {Sample Time} sets the block sample time, {History} sets the infinite or finite data, {Window Length} sets the window size for finite sliding-window, {Estimation Method} sets the recursive estimation algorithm Forgetting, {Forgetting Factor} sets the discount old data using forgetting factor, {Process Noise Covariance} sets the process noise covariance for Kalman filter estimation, {Adaptation Gain} sets the adaptation gain specification for gradient estimation, {Normalization Bias} sets the bias for adaptation gain scaling for normalized gradient estimation method, {Output estimation error} adds Error outport to block, {Output parameter covariance matrix} adds covariance outport to block and {Add enable port} adds Enable inport to block. Values come from the instance.
